simp.text: 他画的花，好像闻得到淡淡的香味。

trad.text: 他畫的花，好像聞得到淡淡的香味。
trad.bpmf: 他畫的花，好像聞得󠇡到淡淡的香味。

example.en: The flowers he painted looked so real you could almost smell their faint fragrance.
I'll paint four dragons.

simp.text: 他站在那面大白墙前面。

trad.text: 他站在那面大白牆前面。
trad.bpmf: 他站在那面大白牆前面。

example.en: He stood in front of that big white wall.
There was a temple called Anle Temple.

simp.text: 这些龙为什么都没有眼睛？

trad.text: 這些龍為什麼都沒有眼睛？
trad.bpmf: 這些龍為󠇡什麼都沒有眼睛？

example.en: Why don't any of these dragons have eyes?

simp.text: 第三条龙嘴巴张得大大的。

trad.text: 第三條龍嘴巴張得大大的。
trad.bpmf: 第三條龍嘴巴張得󠇡大大的。

example.en: The third dragon's mouth was opened wide.
With one flick of its tail...

simp.text: 太阳从云缝里探出头来。

trad.text: 太陽從雲縫裡探出頭來。
trad.bpmf: 太陽從雲縫󠇡裡探出頭來。

example.en: The sun peeked its head out from a gap in the clouds.

simp.text: 拿着一根树枝，在地上画。

trad.text: 拿著一根樹枝，在地上畫。
trad.bpmf: 拿著一󠇢根樹枝，在地上畫。

example.en: He held a tree branch and drew on the ground.
Children were flying kites.

simp.text: 金陵城里街道弯弯曲曲。

trad.text: 金陵城裡街道彎彎曲曲。
trad.bpmf: 金陵城裡街道彎彎曲󠇡曲󠇡。

example.en: The streets of Jinling wound this way and that.
There was a bustling city.
They burrowed into the dark clouds in the sky.

simp.text: 张僧繇放下手里的画笔。

trad.text: 張僧繇放下手裡的畫筆。
trad.bpmf: 張僧繇放下手裡的畫筆。

example.en: Zhang Sengyou set down the paintbrush in his hand.
He dipped up a little bit of black paint.
People use the phrase 'dotting the dragon's eyes'.

simp.text: 金陵城里最有名的画家是张僧繇。

trad.text: 金陵城裡最有名的畫家是張僧繇。
trad.bpmf: 金陵城裡最有名的畫家是張僧繇。

example.en: The most famous painter in Jinling was Zhang Sengyou.
There was a bustling city.

simp.text: 龙是好兆头，又威风，正合适。

trad.text: 龍是好兆頭，又威風，正合適。
trad.bpmf: 龍是好兆頭，又威風，正合適。

example.en: A dragon is a good omen, and it looks majestic. It's just right.

simp.text: 大家都称赞张僧繇这个画家。

trad.text: 大家都稱讚張僧繇這個畫家。
trad.bpmf: 大家都稱讚張僧繇這個󠇡畫家。

example.en: Everyone praised the painter Zhang Sengyou.
At last everyone agreed.
I left them out on purpose.
He had painted them so meticulously.
I painted these four dragons very earnestly.
Trust me this one time.
Aren't you being a little too modest?
Zhang Sengyou felt very awkward inside.
A bolt of lightning streaked across the sky.

simp.text: 最珍贵、最不可或缺的部分。

trad.text: 最珍貴、最不可或缺的部分。
trad.bpmf: 最珍貴、最不可或缺的部分。

example.en: the most precious, most indispensable part

simp.text: 这个故事变成了一个有趣的成语。

trad.text: 這個故事變成了一個有趣的成語。
trad.bpmf: 這個󠇡故事變成了一󠇡個󠇡有趣的成語。

example.en: This story became an interesting idiom.
